0)"],"features":["sbytes","dbytes","spkts","dpkts"],"rationale":"Byte counts and packet counts are non-negative by definition."},{"id":"R2","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['sbytes'] packets."},{"id":"R3","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['dbytes'] == 0) & (df['dpkts'] == 0)"],"features":["dbytes","dpkts"],"rationale":"If no bytes were transmitted from destination direction."},{"id":"R5","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['dpkts'] == 0) & (df['dbytes'] == 0)"],"features":["dpkts","dbytes"],"rationale":"If there are no destination-to-source them."},{"id":"R7","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['dbytes'] > 0) & (df['dpkts'] > 0)"],"features":["dbytes","dpkts"],"rationale":"If bytes were transmitted from destination to count."},{"id":"R9","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['dloss'] >= 0) & (df['dloss'] <= df['dpkts'])"],"features":["dloss","dpkts"],"rationale":"The number of retransmitted or dropped positive."},{"id":"R11","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['dbytes'] > 0) & (df['dmean'] > 0)"],"features":["dbytes","dmean"],"rationale":"If destination bytes were transmitted, the
